sprint: Unified State Reconciliation and PDF Controlled Pilot Planning Sprint
blocked_by: family_status_is_discovery_only — classification does not enable generation; it informs the controlled pilot plan

context.why_zero: discovery_sweep auto-classifier uses static-method heuristic (Cells/Words pattern). Aspose.PDF LowCode uses instance methods via IPlugin pattern. Manual classification required.
context.plugin_pattern: class FooPlugin : IPlugin { public ResultContainer Process(IPluginOptions generalOptions) {...} }
context.key_difference_from_words: Words LowCode: Converter.Convert(input, output) — pure static. PDF LowCode: new Merger().Process(mergeOptions) — instance-based with options object.

WORKFLOW_ROOT.description: Directly executable plugin that produces a document output. Has Process() method. Safe entry point for LLM scenario generation.
criteria: Implements IPlugin or has instance method producing output
Name ends with action verb: Converter, Extractor, Merger, Splitter, Optimizer, Generator, Flattener, Exporter, Importer, Editor

OPTIONS.description: Configuration/options object passed to a WORKFLOW_ROOT. Not directly executable. Should be used by LLM inside the workflow scenario, not as standalone.
criteria: Name contains 'Options', 'Settings', or is clearly a parameter bag
Primarily has properties (getters/setters) rather than methods
Instantiated by user and passed to a WORKFLOW_ROOT

PROVIDER_CALLBACK.description: Interface or abstract class that user must implement to provide data or behavior. Not standalone.
criteria: User provides implementation; pipeline does not generate stubs

RESULT.description: Output container returned by WORKFLOW_ROOT.Process(). Used for validation.
criteria: Has read-only output properties (PageCount, Data, etc.)

DATA_SOURCE.description: Concrete implementation of IDataSource for supplying input to a WORKFLOW_ROOT.

SAVE_TARGET.description: Concrete implementation of ISaveTarget for capturing output.

BUILDER.description: Builder pattern type for constructing complex options objects.

ENUM.description: Enumeration value type. Used as option values.

step_1_identify_workflow_roots.method: Look for types implementing IPlugin or having Process(IPluginOptions) signature
step_1_identify_workflow_roots.alternative: Name ends with Converter, Extractor, Merger, Splitter, Optimizer, Generator, Flattener, Exporter, Importer, Editor AND has public constructor AND has at least 1 non-property public method

step_2_identify_paired_options.method: Each WORKFLOW_ROOT should have a paired Options type (e.g., Merger → MergeOptions, Splitter → SplitOptions)
step_2_identify_paired_options.rule: If XxxOptions exists for a WORKFLOW_ROOT, it is the required input object — must be constructed with AddInput() calls

step_3_identify_data_sources.method: Check for FileDataSource(string path) and StreamDataSource(Stream) constructors
step_3_identify_data_sources.rule: Use FileDataSource(path) as standard input factory for file-based scenarios
step_3_identify_data_sources.rule_for_output: Use FileSaveTarget(path) as standard output factory

step_4_enums_and_result_types.method: Any type with zero methods and enum-like name is ENUM
step_4_enums_and_result_types.result_types: Types in RESULT role are used for output validation only; not generated standalone

scenario_pattern_from_catalog.note: This pattern applies to all WORKFLOW_ROOT types. The difference is the Options type and input/output count.

acceptance_criteria: All 25 preliminary WORKFLOW_ROOT candidates are reviewed and assigned final role: WORKFLOW_ROOT or reclassified
All OPTIONS types verified as not directly executable
Classification unblocks followup-pdf-options-aware-review (which can then identify which WORKFLOW_ROOT types need optional vs required OPTIONS)
estimated_workflow_roots_after_review: 15-25 (25 preliminary, some may be reclassified as utility or data-source)
note: Completing this review does NOT enable PDF generation. Status must remain discovery_only until all 4 PDF taskcards are resolved and human approval given.
